info.name: economizai
info.description: API collection for the economizai backend (NFC-e collaborative price intelligence). Maintain in sync with every endpoint change. The 'E2E Flow' folder runs all requests in logical order — each request seeds variables for the next.

item.name: Categorizer
item.description: ML classifier status + manual triggers + categorization dry-run. Authenticated.

request.description: Dry-run / full chain: how each term would be categorized, with per-layer breakdown (dictionary vs ML), the deciding source, and mlApplied. Nothing is persisted.
The ML model's raw prediction per term (category + genericName + confidence), ignoring the dictionary and the apply gate. Dev tool to inspect/improve the model in isolation.

Runs the categorizer over the golden set and returns accuracyPct (+ failing cases). Track it after each dictionary/model change to see if quality is improving. Also records a snapshot to the quality history.
Snapshots (newest first) from benchmark runs + backfills: accuracyPct (rule correctness) + catalogCoveragePct (how much of the catalog is categorized) over time.

Graduates products corrected by ≥N households to a global category (source USER) and learns recurring agreed tokens into the learned dictionary. Returns { productsGraduated, tokensLearned, learnedTotal }.

item.name: Price index (collaborative)
item.description: K-anonymity-protected aggregates. Will return empty until enough households contribute.

item.name: Deals — Ofertas pra você (watched markets only)
Markets
item.description: Market catalogue (visited + watched + nearby) and the user's watchlist of CNPJs to monitor regardless of distance.

item.name: Price Alerts
item.description: User price-drop alerts ('avise-me quando'). A rule fires when any household's confirmed receipt contributes an observation at or below the threshold (optionally within radiusKm of home). Delivers a PRICE_DROP notification to the inbox + push. One rule per (user, product) — re-posting updates it.

item.name: Notification Rules
item.description: Unified notification rules — create user rules (PRICE_DROP, STOCKOUT/replenishment, BUDGET) and enable/disable any rule including the auto-seeded system defaults (PROMO_PERSONAL, PROMO_COMMUNITY, CHEAPER_MARKET, DIGEST). GET returns user rules + defaults as toggles. PATCH toggles 'active' (and for CHEAPER_MARKET, set radiusKm to also include markets near home in addition to your watched markets). The legacy /api/v1/alerts folder is a thin alias over PRICE_DROP rules.

item.name: Items
item.description: Purchased line items flattened across all receipts. Item-level companion to Receipts (receipt rows) and Insights (aggregates). Same filter vocabulary as /insights/query — every filter optional, multi-value filters OR internally. CONFIRMED purchases only, newest first, paginated.

item.name: List items by category (HOUSEHOLD lens — effective category, default)

query.description: Default. Effective category: excludes products moved to a custom category or another enum.

item.name: List items by category (GLOBAL lens — global Product.category)

query.description: Ignore household overrides; filter by global Product.category (pre-lens behavior).

item.name: Categories
item.description: Household custom categories + product migration. All household-scoped: the global product/catalog is never mutated. GET lists the 9 global enums (id=null, custom=false) plus the household's custom ones. Migrate moves selected products into exactly one target (a global enum OR a custom category).

item.name: List items in a custom category
Consumption (Phase 3)
item.description: Predictive purchase intelligence per household — when products will run out, suggested shopping list. Volume-gated: products with fewer than 2 prior purchases are silently skipped.

item.name: Suggested shopping list with upcoming items
Log manual purchase (Já comprei sem nota)
Shopping list (PRO-52)
item.description: Multi-market basket optimization. Greedy heuristic — for each item picks the cheapest known market (local history first, community index fallback), then groups items per market.

item.name: Shopping lists (persistent)
item.description: Real per-household shopping lists — build, edit, check off as you shop. Items can reference a canonical Product OR be free text.

item.name: Notifications (inbox)
item.description: User-facing inbox for notifications generated by the app (promo alerts, etc).

request.description: Client reports a notification/deal engagement event (telemetry for future relevance ranking). Client-reportable types: PUSH_OPENED, SCREEN_OPENED, DEAL_VIEWED, DEAL_TAPPED, ADDED_TO_LIST, DISMISSED, MUTED. Server-only (SENT/DELIVERED/CONVERTED) and unknown types -> 400. Returns 202.

item.name: Dashboard
item.description: App-open snapshot — bundles spend + recent receipts + suggested list + community promos + unread count.

item.name: Preferences (Phase 2.6)
item.description: Auto-derived per-household pack-size and brand preferences. Volume-gated: a generic with fewer than 5 confirmed purchases is silently skipped.

request.description: Per-household manual override. Wins over the auto-derived dominant brand in GET /preferences.
Drops the override; the row falls back to the auto-derived value (if it has enough purchase volume).
